How do I choose a fast model?Which model is best for chat?What models work for coding?

Together hosts 100+ open-source models across text, image, video, and audio.Most of the models below are for instant [serverless inference](https://docs.together.ai/docs/serverless/models), or reserved hardware deployments with [dedicated model inference](https://docs.together.ai/docs/dedicated-endpoints/models). Both options use the same [inference API](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/overview).

## [​](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/recommended-models\#chat-&-text)  Chat & text

| **Reasoning** | Kimi K3.1 Pro | `moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro` | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, `zai-org/GLM-5.3` | [Reasoning](https://docs.together.ai/docs/inference/chat/reasoning) |

| **Small and fast** | Qwen3.5 9B | `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B` | `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash` | - |
